audit.whatIsWrong: Maokai's Q carries a derived 'grounding' flag in the kit file, which would imply Bramble Smash denies Shadow Dash.
audit.why: Riot's Q text is only 'knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them' — no grounding. Per the brief's own rule, the description wins over a misfiring derived flag.

edits.before: Two tanks farming, but Levels 2-3 are mine. Once I have W into Q I can root Shen in place, swing Bramble Smash, and proc Sap Magic to heal the trade back — he can't replicate that sustain pre-items. His W is the catch: it shields a chunk of incoming autos and ability damage, so don't waste a fresh Q-empowered Passive auto into it. Throw an E sapling to make him eat tick damage and burn the W defensively, then W-Q when the shield is gone.
edits.after: Two tanks farming, but Levels 2-3 are yours. Once you have W into Q you root Shen in place, swing Bramble Smash, and proc Sap Magic to heal the trade back — he can't replicate that sustain pre-items. Spirit's Refuge is the catch, and it blocks attacks only: never spend a fresh Sap Magic auto into it, while your Q, E and the W root all land straight through. Throw an E sapling to bait it out, then W-Q and auto once it drops.
